name: Tyson Foods Sherman Poultry Plant - Sherman TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (33.635662,-96.60888) were city-level Sherman and landed ~6.1 km north of the plant, in the middle of town. The real facility is the Tyson complex on the WEST side of US-75 at the south edge of Sherman, formatted address 4700 US-75, Sherman TX 75090 (Google Places API New, textSearch 'Tyson Foods Sherman Texas plant' -> 33.5807678,-96.6055118). Locked plant/yard center 33.5815,-96.6056.
fieldNotes.identity: Positively Tyson from ground truth, not inference: April 2026 Street View at the west gate (pano VV9oC68x80QiRK89oLO3Bw / 7t8RfGmE1dit2WIqv2MFdw, 33.58200,-96.60815) shows a 'Tyson' sign zip-tied to the barbed-wire perimeter fence and a Tyson Foods 53ft reefer ('We feed the world like family', unit 77398) at the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Roster labels this a Poultry Processing Plant. Imagery shows NO live-haul infrastructure: no coop trailers, no live-bird holding shed with fans, no dead-bird / offal dock. The truck fleet is all dry van and reefer and the yard reads as a further-processing / prepared-foods plant with a very large finished-goods trailer operation. Type kept as given, flagged here.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled. Single truck entrance on the west boundary road at 33.58201,-96.60758: barbed-wire-topped chain-link perimeter, a checkpoint pinch-point with traffic cones channeling trucks past a booth, and a Tyson sign on the fence. Street View (2026-04) shows a tractor-trailer stopped at the booth with two hi-vis staff working the lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Yes. Masonry/brick booth with a flat canopy roof, roughly a 2-vehicle footprint, sitting on an island in the middle of the entrance drive with windows facing both the inbound and outbound lane. Visible in Street View pano 7t8RfGmE1dit2WIqv2MFdw at heading ~87 and as a small structure straddling the drive at z19/z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: An active rail line runs parallel to the west boundary road and the gate drive CROSSES it roughly 40 m outside the booth (rails visible in the Street View foreground and as a dark line at z19). Only ~40 m of stacking exists between the rail crossing and the guard booth, so a two- or three-truck queue at the booth sits on or across the tracks and the road.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Broad paved apron between the road and the gate, west of the fence; a Tyson tractor-trailer is parked on it in the 2026-04 pano. Room for a handful of trucks but it is the same pavement that spans the rail crossing.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate to the nearest dock face is ~200 m of open paved yard; the internal approach easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: The drive at the booth is ~14 m wide with the booth island in the middle, so it reads as one inbound and one outbound lane. No painted lane markings resolvable; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron plus a huge open yard immediately inside; ample unused width to add a bypass / express lane past the booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~40 total, band 25-50. Counted from z19: the north-west-facing dock bank has ~13 trailers backed in along ~62 m of wall (so roughly 16 doors at typical 12 ft centers) and a second, south-facing bank has ~9-10 trailers along ~47 m (roughly 12 doors), plus canopied dock positions at the south end of the building. Overhead counting of doors behind backed-in trailers is inherently approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large. Three distinct trailer-storage areas: the north lot (~5.2 acres, 4 packed rows), a mid lot (~3.1 acres) and a south lot (~2.2 acres, two long facing rows). Well over 50 trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.trailerCounts: trailersVisible 290 and capacity 360 are density estimates (packed nose-in rows at roughly 4 m pitch in ~25 m row bands, cross-checked against measured lot areas). Treat as +/-20 percent, not a hand count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (a north-west-facing bank and a south-facing bank), consistent with split shipping and receiving. Inferred from geometry, not confirmed operationally.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale deck positively isolated in the imagery. A light rectangular pad sits in the drive just west of the booth but resolution at z20 is at its limit; left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: South edge of Sherman TX (pop ~45k) on US-75, with an industrial park to the north and open farmland to the west and south. Small-town industrial, so Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west property boundary and the gate drive crosses it, but no spur was observed entering the fence or serving a building. Called false.
fieldNotes.siteArea: 40.7 acres from the traced perimeter ring, which follows the developed/fenced operational footprint (trailer yards + plant + employee lots). Undeveloped Tyson-owned land beyond the fence, if any, is excluded.
fieldNotes.webResearch: Session WebSearch budget was exhausted for this run, so no press/locator corroboration was pulled. Identity rests on on-site Tyson signage and Tyson-liveried equipment in 2026 Street View plus the Google Places record, which is strong first-party ground truth.

citations.claim: Street View at the plant's west truck gate shows a 'Tyson' sign on the perimeter fence, a manned guard booth and a Tyson Foods reefer at the checkpoint.
Google Places (New) returns 'Tyson Foods Inc', 4700 US-75, Sherman TX 75090 at 33.5807678,-96.6055118, typed manufacturer/wholesaler/food.

verification.rationale: Tyson signage and Tyson-liveried tractors/trailers on site in April 2026 Street View, plus an active manned gate. Divestiture check not run: WebSearch was unavailable for this run. Divestiture/closure gauntlet run 2026-08-12: this site was checked by name against Tyson's announced closures 2023-2026 and does not appear on that list.

divestitureCitation.claim: Tyson closure sweep 2023-2026 checked this site by name against the announced-closure list (2023 poultry: Noel MO, Corydon IN, Glen Allen VA, Van Buren AR; 2024: Perry IA pork, North Little Rock AR; 2025: Emporia KS beef, 2x Original Philly PA prepared; 2026: Lexington NE beef closed Jan 20 2026, Rome GA prepared closing May 31 2026). This site does not appear on it. Checked against agriculturedive.com, kcur.org and wrdw.com reporting; swept 2026-08-12.
